name: toolstorm
description: TOOLSTORM: a playable terminal arcade shooter fueled by Claude Code's real tool calls. Every Edit spawns a bug, every passing test drops a power-up, every failure costs you a heart, and every fifth turn brings a boss. Four modes, a daily challenge, 30 trophies, levels and unlockable ships. Plays in its own pane with a live score HUD in Claude's status line.
